original_test_intent: Retrieve approved BMC message(s), decode source/content/order/freshness and retain evidence without unintended acknowledgement or queue mutation.
original_method: Do not issue any guessed Get. Require exact method, channel/source scope, response schema, consume/acknowledge behavior, bounded queue policy, redaction and acceptance.
manual_activity: Engineer/vendor defines whether reads consume messages and approves scope/redaction; owner later reviews sensitive or unexpected-source results, not routine automated collection.
safety_requirements: Do not enable channels or borrow Send behavior.
Do not dump unbounded queues or expose payload secrets.
Do not acknowledge/clear messages unless explicitly defined and approved.
agent_execution_scope: Static schema/evidence planning only while blocked.
No Get command may be generated or run.
After definition, retrieve only bounded approved messages and parse/redact them.
Verify queue state and return evidence without verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve message scope, retention and redaction.
